qualification.details: Chief Executive Officer: BE / B. Tech. Degree or equivalent degree in Mechanical / Aeronautical / Electrical / Electronics/ Telecommunication / Instrumentation / Production / Electronics & Communication Engineering from a recognized institute. MBA or equivalent Post Graduate Management Degree / Diploma / Certificate preferably in the area of Aeronautical Engineering / Marketing / Materials / finance / HR Management. Experience: External Candidate: Working at Level E-7 and above with 20 years of managerial experience out of which at least 5 years of experience at senior managerial level (not more than two levels below CEO/Head of Institute) in aviation industry. Preference to candidates with experience in large organizations and managing large groups. Internal Candidate: Working at Senior Management Level (E-7 and above) in AIAHL and its subsidiaries with 20 years' experience in Aviation Engineering, out of which at least 10 years should be at managerial level including at least 05 years of experience at senior managerial level (Level E7 or above).

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIESL Chief Executive Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Chief Executive Officer position at AIESL is 12-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the CEO post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BE/B.Tech or equivalent degree in specific engineering disciplines, along with an MBA or equivalent post-graduate management degree/diploma/certificate, preferably in aviation-related fields.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Chief Executive Officer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Chief Executive Officer post is 58 years as of 01-07-2026. There is no mention of a minimum age limit in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. How is the selection process conducted for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Chief Executive Officer role at AIESL is a two-tier process, which primarily involves personal interviews of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Chief Executive Officer position?
faq.answer: The compensation includes a Fixed Gross Emolument of Rs. 3 lakh per month, plus a Special Allowance of 20% and HRA of 30% of the combined emoluments.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for AIESL CEO recruitment?
faq.answer: Based on the provided information, there is no application fee mentioned for the Chief Executive Officer recruitment drive at AIESL.

faq.question: Q7. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a Contract job at AI Engineering Services (AIESL).

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Chief Executive Officer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Chief Executive Officer at AIESL.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their applications via post.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located in New Delhi, with the recruitment being applicable Across India.
